This line tells readers to see CONTRIBUTING, but the repository has no CONTRIBUTING file (no `CONTRIBUTING`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, or equivalent on the branch). Anyone following the new README pointer hits a dead end.

Add a real CONTRIBUTING guide (or link to an existing external contrib doc), or drop this line until that file exists.

summary:
## Verdict

Docs-only PR with one real issue: README points at a CONTRIBUTING guide that is not in the tree.

## Notes

`README.md` now says "See CONTRIBUTING." The repo only contains `README.md` and `poetry.lock` — there is no `CONTRIBUTING`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, or similar path, so the new pointer is a dead reference.

`poetry.lock` is listed as omitted/generated. From the inventory alone it is a one-line version churn alongside a docs edit, with no `pyproject.toml` (or other manifest) in the change set. Worth confirming that lock update was intentional and not accidental noise in the same commit; do not treat the lock blob as reviewed line-by-line.

## Release decision

**Recommendation:** request-changes
